# Kaba Fence

> Local fence and deck installation and repair, with free on-site estimates, for homeowners and businesses in Angier, Raleigh, and nearby North Carolina towns in Harnett, Wake, and Johnston counties.

## Business

- Name: Kaba Fence (Kaba Fence LLC)
- Type: Fence & deck contractor (HomeAndConstructionBusiness)
- Based in: Angier, NC 27501 (service-area business; no storefront)
- Service area: Angier first, plus Raleigh, Fuquay-Varina, Holly Springs, Apex, Cary, Garner, Clayton, Knightdale, Wake Forest, Dunn, Lillington, and nearby Harnett, Wake & Johnston County communities
- Phone: (919) 292-4777
- Email: kabafencellc@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Saturday by appointment; Sunday closed
- Website: https://kabafence.com

## Services

- Wood fencing (privacy, picket) — installation and repair
- Vinyl fencing (low-maintenance privacy)
- Aluminum & ornamental fencing
- Chain-link fencing (galvanized and vinyl-coated)
- Gates and hardware (hinge/latch) upgrades
- Fence repair (posts, panels, gates)
- Residential and commercial fencing
- Deck repair, rebuilds, and new builds
- Deck railings & stairs
- Free on-site estimates with a written quote
